noteGrp.note: A Syriac liturgical supplication attributed to Balai for deceased priests and deacons. The hymn asks that clergy who ministered in the church be joined with Aaron, linking departed Christian ministers with the biblical priesthood. Its traditional attribution to Balai is of the same liturgical corpus whose authorship has been questioned in modern scholarship.
